_doc: The TSD map (iaf-2026/docs/cockpit.md "Display data"): polygons in longitude / latitude (WGS84), filled in order over the background; iaf-sim own compiles it into map.json (the EMF-JSON shape cockpit.gd reads) and isr.png (the GM picture, each layer's radar brightness). Made by tools/iaf-2026/cockpit_displays.py map.
source: OpenStreetMap: simplified land polygons (osmdata.openstreetmap.de, https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/simplified-land-polygons-complete-3857.zip); the relations (id version) 1473946 v345, 3791785 v182, 3791783 v84, 3791784 v105, 7391021 v15, 1473938 v101: Israel 1473946, Area C 3791785, the PA's areas 3791783 (A), 3791784 (B), 7391021 (Hebron H1), 1473938 (Gaza), fetched 2026-11-03 (OSM API); natural=water lakes of 15 km2 or more, OSM data of 2026-11-02 (Overpass)
